# llms.txt — agent entry index for gogogo

> Read AGENTS.md first. It points here for orientation; this file points
> everywhere else. Fetch only what the task needs — do not read the whole
> tree "to be safe" (see `cali-code-navigation`: orient with ripwire first).

## Start here (every task)

- AGENTS.md — commands, don'ts, architecture seams (20-30 lines, normative)
- ARCHITECTURE.md — module layout and seams
- skills/gogogo-coding-standards/SKILL.md — Go + template rules (read when editing .go/.templ)

## By task

- New feature or product plan: docs/overview.md, docs/features.md
- Adding a dependency, or writing something a library could do (write-vs-rent,
  the ordered procedure, the four human-gated cases): docs/dependency-principles.md
- Search layers (substring / fuzzy / BM25), the runtime picker, the trim story: docs/search.md
- What a unit owns (routes, generated queries, trim story): docs/unit-contracts.md
  (generated; scaffold with `gogogo new feature <name>`)
- Architecture details: docs/architecture.md, docs/architecture-decision.md
- Config and env vars: docs/configuration.md
- Local CI and gates: docs/local-ci.md
- Keeping a scaffolded project current (base marker, --check-update, migrate, `migrate --files` for which files apply to you, `advise --intent update`): docs/upgrading.md
- Taking one unit into an app that already exists (read-only export bundle + porting checklist): docs/porting-into-an-existing-app.md
- Realtime, queue, offline: docs/async-layers.md
- Auth and sessions: internal/auth/ (owned argon2id sessions), features/authviews/ (login UI)
- AI credits and billing: docs/llm-and-credits.md, features/credits/
- Installer (scaffold/trim/add units): internal/installer/, cmd/gogogo/README.md
  (`gogogo new feature <name>` scaffolds one unit; MCP equivalent: `new_feature`)
- Trim presets (minimal/no-ai/no-collab): internal/installer/trim_presets.go (`--preset`)
- Going without auth/database (fork recipe): docs/no-auth-no-db-recipe.md
- HTTP route inventory (generated, do not edit): docs/api-routes.md
- Deploy: docs/deploy.md
- Troubleshooting: docs/troubleshooting.md

## Invariants (do not relearn these)

- Flat stack only: chi handlers + dbgen queries, no framework.
- A new direct dependency needs a pass through docs/dependency-principles.md and
  a one-line trade-off record in the PR body; raising the native floor (a new
  CGO/native library, build tool, or runtime library) is a human gate.
- `go run ./cmd/check-flatdeps` proves it — run before committing.
- Generated code is committed and drift-checked (`make check-generated`).
- Counts are generated, never hand-written: `docs/unit-contracts.md` is the source; `make check-docs` gates counts, dead paths, invented subcommands, and MANIFEST coverage.
- `//nolint` is last resort (skill documents the procedure; CI enforces it).
- Never edit `site/docs/` (generated output).
